collision.derivation: exact convex hull (integer arithmetic) of every LOD0 render vertex position after binary32 rounding; its vertices are exactly the extreme points
collision.gltf_representation: triangle mesh (mode 4) with POSITION and indices only, no material, as the only root of the non-default scene 'forge_collision'

coordinates.conversion: none: native glTF 2.0 frame; engine-side axis and unit conversion is the importer's job

collision_sha256.covers: semantic: b'forge.engine.collision.v1\0', node name, NUL, u32 vertex count, u32 index count, POSITION 3xf32, indices as u32; little-endian

gltf_bin_sha256.covers: the GLB BIN chunk data exactly as stored, including its trailing zero padding

gltf_json_sha256.covers: the GLB JSON chunk data exactly as stored, including its trailing space padding

manifest_content_sha256.covers: canonical JSON of this manifest with hashes.manifest_content_sha256 removed

pbr_materials_sha256.covers: canonical JSON of the glTF materials array exactly as stored in the GLB

render_geometry_sha256.covers: semantic, layout-independent: b'forge.engine.render-geometry.v1\0' then, per LOD0 render node in manifest order: node name, NUL, material name, NUL, u32 vertex count, u32 index count, POSITION 3xf32, NORMAL 3xf32, TEXCOORD_0 2xf32, indices as u32; little-endian

semantic_sha256.covers: canonical JSON of {contract: {id, version}, coordinates, lods, collision_sha256, pbr_materials_sha256, render_geometry_sha256, sockets_sha256}

sockets_sha256.covers: canonical JSON of [{name, parent, translation, rotation}] for each socket node, in node order

source_geometry_sha256.covers: provenance: Forge's Step 2 integrity hash geometry_sha256 of the source asset; reproducible with Forge from the asset section, not from this package

source_materials_sha256.covers: provenance: Forge's Step 2 integrity hash materials_sha256 of the source asset; reproducible with Forge from the asset section, not from this package

source_normals_sha256.covers: provenance: Forge's Step 2 integrity hash normals_sha256 of the source asset; reproducible with Forge from the asset section, not from this package

source_obj_format1_sha256.covers: provenance: Forge's Step 2 integrity hash obj_format1_sha256 of the source asset; reproducible with Forge from the asset section, not from this package

source_uvs_sha256.covers: provenance: Forge's Step 2 integrity hash uvs_sha256 of the source asset; reproducible with Forge from the asset section, not from this package

lods.note: LOD0 only. Contract v1 declares no reduced levels and none are generated.

materials.base_color_space: linear (Forge material v1 factors, passed through unchanged)
materials.procedural_patterns: not baked: no textures are written; parameters are informational

presentation.texcoord_0: (u, 1 - v) of Forge uv v1: glTF's UV origin is the image's top-left

sockets.derivation: the asset origin, which the coordinate convention defines as the grip center (checked: grip bounding-box center within 1e-9 m of the origin)
sockets.frame: asset axes, identity rotation: +Y along the blade toward the tip, +X toward the cutting edges, +Z out of the blade flats
sockets.name: socket_grip

sockets.derivation: the blade apex: the unique blade vertex with the greatest y (the top point of the blade loft), rounded to binary32
sockets.frame: asset axes, identity rotation: +Y along the blade toward the tip, +X toward the cutting edges, +Z out of the blade flats
sockets.name: socket_tip
